entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You ready?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The games are on me today...[n]Just be sure to keep up.
I can pay for myself.
If you insist.
Do you have enough?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't worry, I have a lot of[n]money on me today!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Now, let's get to it! [n]Get into your stance!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No! No! Too slow!
Shinya is playing erratically...

entries.speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
entries.en: Hey!

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: Give him his money back.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What the...? Just ignore them.

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: Oda!

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: You took his lunch money, didn't you!?

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: He forced you into a battle, right?

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: And when I lost... He told me I[n]owed him money.

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: Who do you think you are!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...The King.

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I didn't take it... I earned it. That money is[n]for my war fund, to help get me stronger.

entries.speaker: Reserved Boy
entries.en: What the hell does that mean?[n]You're crazy, just like your mom.

entries.speaker: Reserved Boy
entries.en: I heard your mom was being weird at[n]a restaurant the other day, too.

entries.speaker: Reserved Boy
entries.en: A waiter caught her leaving without[n]paying, and she said that she just forgot.

entries.speaker: Reserved Boy
entries.en: She even snapped at the manager and[n]told him his employees need to be[n]better trained.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Sh-Shut up...!

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: My mom says that your mom is a bully!

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: And you're just like her!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up![n]I'm the strongest! The best! The King!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If you want your money back,[n]you'll have to beat me!

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: He's not making any sense...

entries.speaker: Defiant Boy
entries.en: Somehow, some way, you're gonna[n]pay us back!

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: The only thing you're good at is[n]playing games...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: You're just like the bad guy in a movie!

entries.speaker: Quiet Boy
entries.en: I hope the Phantom Thieves get you!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: A bad guy...? Me...? R-Really?[n]Even though I'm strong?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm not a bad guy... am I...?
You should return the money.
You're acting like one.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But I won... I'm the stronger one...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So how am I... the bad guy...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No I'm not... I mean, I won... I got stronger,[n]just like the Phantom Thieves did...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So how am I... the bad guy...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I guess I... I already knew that...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I felt bad... even when I was winning.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I won't do it again... [n]I don't wanna be a bad guy.
That's good.
I believe in you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah... I guess it's the right thing to do.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Um... do you... hate me now?
A little bit.
Not at all.[clr 27]
I'm worried about you.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Wh-What? No...! If you hate me too, then...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'll never do anything bad again! I swear!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So please, just...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Really? Like, really really you don't?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, that's great! I don't want you to[n]hate me too...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Sorry. I promise that I won't[n]do that again...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So please don't hate me...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are strong because[n]they defeat strong enemies, right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Beating up on weak opponents... that's[n]bullying... That's what bad guys do.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I was wrong.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thanks, [lName]-san... I wouldn't[n]have realized this on my own.
I feel Shinya's[n]brotherly affection...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm gonna head home now.[n]I need to think about what I did...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'll see you later... Bye.
